no_investment_advice.rule: No investment advice. A demo is not a recommendation to invest, lend, or act. A demo is a demonstration of internal validation work.

no_guaranteed_returns.rule: No guaranteed returns. A demo does not guarantee any return. The model is a screening tool, not a guarantee instrument.

no_bankability.rule: No bankability. A demo does not establish bankability. The model is a screening tool, not a bank-grade product.

no_saas_ready_claims.rule: No SaaS-ready claims. A demo does not establish SaaS readiness. The model is internal, not multi-tenant, not SLA-backed.

per_slide_checklist_template.note: Each demo slide or demo section must be reviewed against this checklist. The checklist is recorded per slide / per section in this file (when populated).

fields.note: B11 claim category (CAT-001 through CAT-017) or new category if not covered

verdict_rules.pass: Approved for the demo. Claim is consistent with the B11 rules and the absolute prohibition rules.
verdict_rules.fail: Not approved for the demo. Claim violates the B11 rules or the absolute prohibition rules. The slide / section must be removed or rewritten.
verdict_rules.conditional: Approved only if the required context is added. The slide / section must include the required context before the demo.
verdict_rules.not_applicable: The slide / section does not contain a claim that requires review.

global_notes: This checklist is empty at package creation. It is populated when a demo is reviewed slide-by-slide. The checklist is the per-slide record of the demo claims review.

The four absolute prohibition rules (no_investment_advice, no_guaranteed_returns, no_bankability, no_saas_ready_claims) are absolute. They are not relaxed by the B11 safe harbor statements, the B19 demo flow, the B12 heatmap labels, or the B3 matrix evidence categories.

The 11 prohibited demo claim categories mirror the B11 prohibited claims register, with demo-specific tightening (no customer reference, no external validation, no production readiness are added to the demo flow as explicit prohibitions).

The 9 allowed demo flow steps are a guideline. Segments may be reordered if the reordering is consistent with the B11 rules. Segments may not be removed if their content is required (e.g. the generic solar / wind statement is mandatory before any discussion of generic technology).

A demo that violates the prohibited claims list triggers a guardrail violation. The remedy is to revert the violation (scrub the script, edit the recording, or cancel the demo), identify how it happened, and update the process to prevent recurrence.

Claude review is separate. The Phase 51N checkpoint includes a Claude review preparation pack on the Agent A side; Claude review itself is handled outside this branch and is not represented in B19 as completed.
